expert_take: The 2025 Chevrolet Silverado 1500 is a full-size pickup available with a variety of trim levels and powertrains. It starts with a 310-horsepower turbocharged four-cylinder and tops out with a 420-hp V-8. The available Duramax diesel engine offers the top towing capacity of 13,300 pounds and an EPA-rated 24 mpg combined. The cabin has a standard 13.4-inch touchscreen.

expert_take: The 2025 Ford F-150 is a versatile full-size pickup that offers a choice of gasoline V-6 and V-8 engines, including a hybrid with an optional high-output power generator. Among several noteworthy versions are the high-performance Raptor trims. With a towing capacity of 8,200-13,500 pounds, the F-150 remains a perennial bestseller for its balance of toughness and modern features.

expert_take: The 2026 Honda Accord, a top mid-size sedan, gains a standard 9-inch touchscreen and wireless smartphone connectivity. Hybrid models deliver up to 48 mpg combined and 204 horsepower, while gas versions reach 32 mpg combined with 192 hp. The standard Honda Sensing safety suite includes lane-centering steering and adaptive cruise control, and most trims add blind spot monitoring.

expert_take: The 2025 Honda Civic is an appealing compact sedan or hatchback with excellent ride and handling. A hybrid variant features a 200-horsepower powertrain delivering 49 mpg combined; the hotter Civic Si and Type R add performance to the lineup. Every Civic has a spacious, upscale interior and standard safety tech that includes adaptive cruise control and lane departure steering assist.

The hybrid is the efficiency leader with fuel economy up to 49 mpg combined, while standard gas models get up to 36 mpg combined. Top trim levels get a 9-inch touchscreen and Bose audio. The standard Honda Sensing safety suite includes lane departure steering assist and adaptive cruise control.

expert_take: The 2025 Honda CR-V is a top-tier compact SUV known for its spacious interior and composed ride quality. It offers a 190-horsepower, turbocharged four-cylinder engine or a 204-hp hybrid with strong fuel economy. While it lacks spirited handling, it includes many standard driver aids like lane departure steering assist and adaptive cruise control to enhance safety.

expert_take: The 2025 Jeep Wrangler is an iconic off-roader with vast capability but poor on-road refinement and EPA-rated fuel economy (19-21 mpg combined). While it features a 12.3-inch touchscreen and standard power locks, the cabin is bare-bones. Safety is a concern, with marginal IIHS crash scores and a lack of standard collision avoidance systems.

expert_take: The 2025 Subaru Outback is a refined SUV with a wagonlike driving character and standard all-wheel drive. Engine choices include a 182-horsepower, 2.5-liter flat-four-cylinder or a turbocharged 2.4-liter flat-four that makes 260 hp. Known for a buttery ride and ample ground clearance, it’s a top road-trip choice. Note that a boxier redesign is coming for the 2026 model year.

expert_take: The 2025 Tesla Model 3 is a compact electric sedan with a 298-363-mile EPA-rated range. It features a 15.4-inch infotainment touchscreen and an 8-inch rear touchscreen. While quick and updated with a quieter ride, its unorthodox steering-wheel controls and screen-based gear selector may be deal breakers. Safety tech like blind spot warning and adaptive cruise control comes standard.

expert_take: The 2025 Toyota Camry transitions to a hybrid-only lineup, offering up to 51 mpg combined. This mid-size sedan features a refreshed interior with available 12.3-inch displays and improved refinement. While the Camry loses the V-6 engine option, the efficient hybrid powertrain makes up to 232 horsepower. A sedan leader, the Camry offers a refined driving experience.

expert_take: The 2025 Toyota RAV4 is an appealing compact SUV that comes with a gas engine and hybrid powertrain or plug-in hybrid powertrain, both with standard all-wheel drive. The base four-cylinder engine makes 203 horsepower; the hybrid ups that to 219 hp; and the PHEV makes 302 hp with a 42-mile electric range and 38 mpg combined. Inside, it offers 8- or 10.5-inch touchscreens.
notable_features: Five-seat compact SUV Front- or all-wheel drive Gas, hybrid and plug-in hybrid versions Wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
good_points: Fuel economy, especially from hybrid versions

expert_take: The 2026 Toyota Sienna is a minivan that comes solely with a hybrid powertrain. It offers up to 36 mpg combined with front-wheel drive and 35 mpg with all-wheel drive. Standard safety includes Toyota Safety Sense 2.0 with collision warning and lane assist. Available in seven- or eight-passenger layouts, the Sienna features updated standard tech like an 8-or 12.3-inch touchscreen.

expert_take: The 2026 Toyota Tacoma mid-size pickup offers eight trims and hybrid or turbo engines. Standard Safety Sense 3.0 provides advanced driver assists. Rear-wheel-drive models get up to 21/26/23 mpg city/highway/combined, while four-wheel-drive automatics see up to 20/23/21 mpg. Hybrids reach 22/24/23 mpg. With various cab and bed options, it remains a highly versatile mid-size pickup for any buyer.

expert_take: The 2026 Toyota Tundra offers gas and hybrid V-6 engines with up to 437 horsepower and 583 pounds-feet of torque. It includes standard safety tech like blind spot monitoring. Gas models get up to 18/23/20 mpg, while hybrids reach 20/24/22 mpg. New for 2026 are availablke features like specialized off-road seats, updated leather upholstery and expanded lift-kit availability across various trims.
